evals.name: kanban_app_spec
evals.prompt: Create a complete project specification for a real-time Kanban board web application built with React, Vite, and Supabase.
evals.expected_output: Generates all 6 spec files (PRD.md, Architecture.md, Rules.md, Phases.md, Design.md, Memory.md) with tailored React and Supabase details.
assertions: All 6 specification files (PRD.md, Architecture.md, Rules.md, Phases.md, Design.md, Memory.md) are generated.
PRD.md includes target user personas and core real-time Kanban features.
Architecture.md includes React and Supabase tech stack and folder layout.
Rules.md lists explicit AI boundaries and prohibited libraries.
Phases.md defines sequential phase milestones for development.

evals.name: cli_tool_spec
evals.prompt: Generate full project specification docs for a Python CLI log parsing and analysis tool named LogGazer.
evals.expected_output: Generates all 6 spec files tailored for a Python CLI application.
assertions: All 6 specification files are generated in the target directory.
PRD.md defines CLI commands and log parsing requirements.
Architecture.md specifies Python dependencies and CLI module structure.
Design.md defines terminal UI styling, colors, and output formatting.

evals.name: ecommerce_api_spec
evals.prompt: Set up project spec files for an e-commerce REST API backend built with Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL.
evals.expected_output: Generates all 6 spec files with database schemas, API routes, and backend rules.
assertions: Architecture.md outlines Express route structures and PostgreSQL models.
Rules.md defines error handling and authentication security boundaries.
Memory.md initializes progress tracking for initial development.
